Container.Name: expenses-dashboard
Container.Overview:
Mobile-first, read-only dashboard for SQLite expense snapshots. One FastAPI process serves both the API and the built React app; SQLite only, no external database or worker. Intended to sit behind Nginx Proxy Manager Basic Access Authentication (the app itself has no login); reached through a Cloudflare Tunnel. The container listens on port 8000 only inside the custom network; no host port is published. The producer publishes a consistent snapshot and its exact-name `.ready` marker into the incoming directory.
Unraid's template editor cannot express every hardening control used by the local compose file (read-only root filesystem, `cap_drop: ALL`, `no-new-privileges`, the bounded `/tmp` tmpfs). The image itself runs a single non-root Uvicorn worker. If Extra Arguments such as `--read-only --cap-drop ALL` are applied, they are passed verbatim to `docker run`; verify with `docker inspect` after creating the container and compare against the compose file before exposing anything.

Config.Name: Dashboard data
Config.Description: Application state, WAL files, import staging, persisted FX rates, retained snapshots. Must be owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: Incoming snapshots
Config.Description: Completed snapshot pairs from the producer; the application only reads this directory.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Exact externally visible HTTPS origin with no path, as configured in Cloudflare/NPM (for example https://expenses.example.com). Required for the app to start.

Config.Name: FX_POLL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Stored historical-rate refresh interval in seconds.

Config.Name: REPORT_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Dashboard and FX-date policy timezone (IANA name).

Config.Name: MAX_IMPORT_BYTES
Config.Description: Maximum accepted snapshot candidate size in bytes.

Config.Name: SNAPSHOT_RETENTION
Config.Description: Successful local raw snapshot copies retained in /data.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone for logs; report timezone is set separately.
